title: OAuth Authorization Server Metadata
description: The RFC 8414 metadata the Company's auth.issuer publishes, with the fields Poppy requires. Spec section 3.2 (OAuth server). Other fields are allowed, and Personal Agents ignore them. authorization_endpoint is required when poppy.json has auth.direct, and device_authorization_endpoint when it has auth.device; those depend on poppy.json and are checked separately.

dpop_signing_alg_values_supported.description: The JWS algorithms the Company accepts for DPoP Proofs (RFC 9449 section 5.1). It must include ES256, which is checked separately.
